datasets.title: Critical IT capacity at reviewed completed sites
datasets.unit: MW of rated critical IT capacity
datasets.description: Selected site evidence, not a national inventory. Rated critical IT capacity is not actual load, GPU capacity or an Africa total.

rows.label: Teraco JB4, South Africa
rows.source: Teraco JB4 expansion completion
rows.note: 50 MW is total critical IT capacity after a 30 MW addition. Actual utilisation and AI-specific capacity are not reported. JB4 is a different facility from JB7 in the project pipeline; do not add its incremental 30 MW again. Evidence: operator_statement. Reviewed 2026-10-01. Operator reports completion of a 30 MW addition, bringing the JB4 campus to 50 MW critical IT capacity. Total and increment must not be added. Rated capacity is not actual electricity consumption or AI-specific compute.
